# Support

Looking for help with the Kartoza Timesheet App? Here's how you can get support:

## Getting Help

### 📚 Documentation

Start with our comprehensive documentation:

- [README](../README.md) - Project overview and quick start
- [Contributing Guidelines](CONTRIBUTING.md) - Development setup and guidelines
- [Requirements](../REQUIREMENTS.md) - Detailed project specifications
- [Brand Guidelines](BRAND.md) - Visual identity and design standards

### 🐛 Bug Reports

Found a bug? Please check our [existing issues](https://github.com/timlinux/kartoza-timesheet-app/issues) first, then:

1. Use our [Bug Report Template](.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.md)
2. Provide detailed reproduction steps
3. Include your environment details
4. Attach relevant screenshots or logs

### 💡 Feature Requests

Have an idea for improvement? We'd love to hear it:

1. Check [existing feature requests](https://github.com/timlinux/kartoza-timesheet-app/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Aenhancement)
2. Use our [Feature Request Template](.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.md)
3. Explain the problem and your proposed solution
4. Describe the use cases and benefits

### 💬 Discussions

For general questions, ideas, and community interaction:

- [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/timlinux/kartoza-timesheet-app/discussions)
- Share your experiences
- Ask for advice
- Discuss best practices

## Support Channels

### Primary Channels

| Channel | Purpose | Response Time |
|---------|---------|---------------|
| [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/timlinux/kartoza-timesheet-app/issues) | Bug reports, feature requests | 1-3 business days |
| [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/timlinux/kartoza-timesheet-app/discussions) | General questions, community | Community-driven |
| Email: tim@kartoza.com | Direct contact with maintainer | 3-5 business days |

### Community Support

Our community is built on the Ubuntu philosophy: *"I am because we are"*

- **Help others**: Answer questions when you can
- **Share knowledge**: Document solutions and workarounds
- **Be inclusive**: Welcome newcomers and different perspectives
- **Stay positive**: Maintain a constructive and helpful attitude

## Before Asking for Help

To get the best help quickly, please:

1. **Search existing issues and discussions** - Your question might already be answered
2. **Check the documentation** - Many common questions are covered in our docs
3. **Include context** - Provide relevant details about your setup and what you've tried
4. **Be specific** - Clear, detailed questions get better answers
5. **Follow up** - Let us know if suggestions work or if you need clarification

## How We Can't Help

While we'd love to help everyone, there are some limitations:

- **Custom implementations** - We can't provide free consulting for custom deployments
- **Third-party integrations** - Support for external tools is limited
- **Debugging production issues** - We can guide you, but can't troubleshoot live systems
- **Urgent requests** - All support is provided on a best-effort basis

## Getting Priority Support

For organizations needing guaranteed response times or custom support:

- **Professional Services**: Contact tim@kartoza.com for consulting options
- **Sponsorship**: Consider sponsoring the project for enhanced support
- **Enterprise Support**: Custom support agreements available for qualifying organizations

## Contributing Back

The best way to ensure continued support is to contribute back:

- **Documentation improvements** - Help others by improving our docs
- **Bug fixes** - Submit PRs for issues you encounter
- **Testing** - Help test new features and report issues
- **Community support** - Answer questions and help other users

## Response Time Expectations

| Issue Type | Expected Response Time |
|------------|----------------------|
| Security vulnerability | Within 48 hours |
| Critical bug (data loss, security) | 1-2 business days |
| Regular bug | 2-5 business days |
| Feature request | 3-7 business days |
| General question | Community-driven |
| Documentation question | 3-5 business days |

*Note: Response times are best-effort and may vary during holidays or high-volume periods.*

## Emergency Contacts

For security vulnerabilities or critical issues:

- **Security**: security@kartoza.com
- **Critical Issues**: tim@kartoza.com (mark subject as "URGENT")

## Thank You

Thank you for using the Kartoza Timesheet App and for being part of our community. Your feedback, questions, and contributions help make this project better for everyone!

*Remember: The best support often comes from the community. Consider helping others when you can!*
